evidence_quote: So, the work rate of 3 builders is 1 cottage / (3 builders * 8 days).
question_evidence_quote: it takes 8 days for 3 builders to build a cottage
observed_error: The response labels a per-builder work rate as the combined rate of three builders.
violated_condition: The three-builder team's rate is one cottage divided by eight days; dividing additionally by three gives the rate per builder.
error_description: The response divides one cottage by both three builders and eight days, then identifies this as the work rate of the three-builder team. That expression measures output per builder per day, whereas the team's combined daily output is one cottage divided by eight days.
secondary_errors: Step 5 writes time as half the three-builder work rate instead of the reciprocal of twice that rate.
Step 7 simplifies (1/2) × (1/(3 × 8)) to 1/16, although the written product is 1/48.
The final answer states 16 days despite Step 7 stating 1/16 days.
